Use disjoint calibration and held-out sets. After equal warm-up and compilation, run repeated randomized interleaved paired baseline/treatment trials with preregistered sample size, scoring rubric, stopping rule, and confidence-interval method. Match or stratify prompt length, batch shape, cache state, placement, kernel route, and thermal state. Report raw per-trial results and uncertainty.

Risks and controls: request mix, cache warmness, compiler autotuning, scheduler behavior, thermal drift, kernel fallback, retries, and underpowered quality/safety samples can confound results.
